comment.narrative: Draft Minimum Standard of Care Guideline for Institute of Children in Conflict with Law has been drafted and under review by the DSS. The Guidelines for the Child Protection Services hub were developed and approved by the DirectorGeneral of DSS. Following this guideline a child protection services hub will be extended to cities like Khulna currently in Barisal and Chattogram to create temporary shelter and recreational facilities for children living in the street. Along with the Minimum Standards of Care other alternative care support documents will be developed after completion of the Alternative Care Study. Economic Policy Research Institute EPRI and Mitra have been selected to conduct the Alternative Care Study. Currently the contractual modalities are being finalized. The study is expected to start within the first quarter of 2022.
